discharge_terms:
Kindly follow all instructions otherwise vet will not be responsible for any mishap with your pet at your place, In case any emerency prior to the follow-up visit date, bring the pet to the clinic.
Instructions after every surgery

  • Don't feed 6 hours after waking up from anesthesia or sedation.
  • Must give medicines as prescribed by veterinarian.
  • Must put on e-collar for 7 days.
  • Apply wound cream at least twice a day for 7 days.
  • Shower is not allowed 7 days after surgery.
  • In case stitches are open or wound get infected, bring back to clinic for concerned vet.
  • Free follow-up within 5 days after surgery.
  • لا تطعم حيوانك الأليف إلا بعد 6 ساعات من الاستيقاظ من التخدير أو التهدئة.
  • يجب إعطاء الأدوية كما هو موصوف من قبل الطبيب البيطري.
  • يجب وضع الطوق لمدة 7 أيام.
  • يوضع كريم الجرح على الأقل مرتين يومياً لمدة 7 أيام.
  • لا يسمح بالاستحمام إلا بعد 7 أيام من الجراحة.
  • في حالة فتح الغرز أو إصابة الجرح بالعدوى، يجب إعادتها إلى العيادة للطبيب البيطري.
  • متابعة مجانية خلال 5 أيام بعد الجراحة.

Terms & Conditions:

  1. My Pets does not bear any responsibility neither nor indirectly nor consequential concerning the pet during or after the service or during the transportation.
  2. My Pets does not bear any responsibility towards the illness and injuries of the pet during or after the service, or any damages or loss when using any products of the company facilities.
  3. My Pets is not responsible for any substantial, psychological or moral indemnity.
  4. Service may be cancelled if the pet is ill, injured, aggressive, pregnant or not vaccinated or small kitten/puppy.
  5. My Pets can cancel the service at any time with reimbursing the customer with the amount paid.
  6. A 10 BD per day fee will be charged if the client failed to pick up the pet after the service.
  7. No customer can be present within the grooming area.
  8. Some pets may require the use of sedation during services.
  9. The owner cannot come to claim the pet after three days from the date of the service and the company has full action towards the pet.
  10. My Pets is not responsible for any damaged, stolen or lost pet accessories, before or after the grooming service.

شروط وقوانين

  1. ماي بيتس لا تتحمل أي مسؤولية مباشرة أو غير مباشرة فيما يتعلق بالحيوانات أثناء أو بعد الخدمة أو أثناء الانتقالات.
  2. ماي بيتس لا تتحمل مسؤولية تجاه أمراض أو إصابات الحيوان أثناء أو بعد الخدمة، أو أي أضرار أو خسائر عند استخدام منتجات مرافق الشركة.
  3. الشركة غير مسؤولة عن أي تعويض سواءً مادي أو نفسي أو معنوي.
  4. يتم إلغاء الخدمة إذا كان الحيوان مريض، مصاب، عدواني، حامل، غير مطعّم أو قطط صغيرة / جرو صغير.
  5. للشركة الحق في إلغاء الخدمة في أي وقت مع تعويض العميل بالمبلغ المدفوع.
  6. سيتم تقاضي مبلغ ١٠ د.ب يوميًا في حالة عدم استلام الحيوان بعد الخدمة.
  7. لا يسمح للزبائن بالتواجد داخل منطقة التجميل أثناء الخدمة.
  8. بعض من الحيوانات الأليفة تتطلب استخدام المخدر أثناء الخدمات.
  9. المالك لا يمكنه المطالبة بالحيوان بعد مرور ٣ أيام من تاريخ الخدمة، والشركة يحق لها التصرف بالحيوان.
  10. ماي بيتس غير مسؤولة عن ضياع أو سرقة أو تلف أي إكسسوارات للحيوان الأليف قبل أو بعد خدمة التجميل.

sedation_terms:

I acknowledge that there are certain risks to anesthesia and treatment that could involve serious bodily injury or death to my pet and that these risks are present in any procedure that requires a general or intravenous anesthetics and treatment. I agree to the use of anesthesia as considered necessary and advisable by the Veterinarian.

I am aware that upon grooming skin problem may be observed by the groomer and if such arises I have to be informed and I shall bring my pet to the veterinarian in the establishment and shall not make issues that the establishment was responsible for such action.

surgery_form:
I give voluntary and informed consent to My Pets Veterinary Center for my pet to undergo the treatments, surgery, or any Services.I am aware that if my animal has any fleas, ticks, or other external or internal parasites, he/she will be treated at my expense.

For the Pets safety, My Pets Veterinary Center recommend doing a blood test for a patient prior to surgery which will check the conditions of the animal's heart, kidney, and liver.

I the owner of the pet acknowledge that there are certain risks going into surgery without checking the condition of these organs and the clinic is not at fault should something happen.

My Pets Veterinary Center requires your pet be fasted prior to anesthesia No food or water or medications should be given before /after the surgery and to follow the veterinarian advice strictly.

I authorize the use of anesthesia and other medication as deemed necessary by the veterinarian. My Pets Veterinary Center may require pain management before, during, and after surgery.

I consent to the use of these medications and understand it may be necessary to give my pet post-operative medication at home.

I have been advised as to the nature of this procedure to be performed and the risks involved. I understand also that there is always a risk associated with anesthesia, even in apparently healthy animals, and have discussed any concerns with my veterinarian. I understand that it may be necessary to provide emergency medical and/or surgical procedures which are not anticipated for the safety and care of my pet. I hereby consent to and authorize the performance of such altered and/or additional procedures as are necessary in the veterinarian’s professional judgement. I hereby certify that I have read and fully understand the above authorization for medical and/or surgical treatment, the reasons why surgery is necessary, its advantages and possible complications. The attending veterinarian will use reasonable precautions for the well-being of my pet but will not be held liable for conditions beyond his/her control.

My signature on this consent form indicates that any questions have been answered to my satisfaction. I authorize My Pets Veterinary Center to perform any additional diagnostic, treatment, or surgical procedure(s) deemed necessary for medical complications or otherwise unforeseen circumstances. I understand there are rare complications associated with any anesthetic procedure. No warranty or guarantee has been given to me as to the results or cure afforded by these treatments or procedures. I fully understand these risks and understand the veterinarians and hospital staff will try to minimize such risks. I will not hold My Pets Veterinary Center, the veterinarians, or any staff member liable for any complications that may arise. I agree to be responsible for any charges incurred while my pet is in the care of My Pets Veterinary Center, a treatment care plan has been provided to me, and I understand all payment will be in advance and if any extra due will be paid at the time my pet is discharged from the clinic. I understand that if my pet requires overnight roundthe-clock specialty or emergency care, I may be referred to a 24-hour emergency veterinary hospital and my pet will require owner-provided transportation prior to the end of day at My Pets Veterinary Center.
